series.note: Day 1 order disputed between outlets (KC-C9 or FURIA-MVK first); both start after the 11:00 PDT Pick'Ems lock.
series.key_matchup: Top lane: Canna (KC; domestic playoffs GD@15 +253, 16 solo kills, Rumble 8-2) vs Thanatos (C9; GD@15 -191, XPD@15 -223, Worlds debut). KC's early game runs through Canna and Yike (Vi 8-3); C9's jungler Blaber is the weakest early-game stat line of the four Play-In junglers on record (XPD@15 -496, CSD@15 -6.4).
series.draft_angle: KC's comforts Rumble, Vi and Seraphine/Rakan (Busio 12-3 combined) are the bans to watch; opponents banned Rumble 22% domestically. C9 lean on Blaber Nocturne (2-0) but Nocturne is a top-2 ban everywhere. Fearless Bo5 tests C9's thinner sampled pools (>=8 champions per player in an 11-game sample) more than KC's 13-19.
series.form_context: KC: 9-0 Summer regular season, then 1-3 G2 and 0-3 MSI in playoffs (1-6 in games), but EWC runner-up in July and 5-4 in 2026 international series. C9: 8-7 in Summer playoffs, ended with back-to-back 1-3 losses (TLAW, LYON). No 2026 head-to-head.
series.what_flips: KC's baron control collapses internationally (26%). If C9 survive lane and drag games past 30 minutes, Vulcan's playmaking (KDA 7.3, 81.7% KP) and C9's 56% dragon / 60% herald control can win the long game, plus a home crowd in LA.

finals_mvp.reason: Gen.G's win condition is Ruler as the carry (31.7% damage, 25.4% gold share in LCK playoffs) and he was LCK Finals MVP on 13/09/2026. Chovy is the close alternative.

single_biggest_risk.assumption: That the LCK is clearly the strongest region (+0.39 logit over the LPL after temperature scaling, worth about 60-40 per game between equal teams) and Gen.G its best team. Four of the model's top five and the predicted champion depend on it, yet LCK vs LPL was only 5-5 in 2026 series and Gen.G's own international record (0-3 G2, 1-2 DK) was weak.
single_biggest_risk.early_detection: Watch LCK vs LPL results in Swiss rounds 1-3 (Bo1s from 23/10). If LPL teams win the majority of those cross-region matches, and/or Gen.G drops a Bo1 to a Tier 4 team, the region gap is overstated and the staged Swiss/Knockout re-run should shrink it.

crystal_ball.question: Which champion will have the highest presence?
crystal_ball.reason: Orianna leads presence across 2026 for Worlds teams (71.8%, wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)) and led MSI 2026 (64.8%, gol.gg). Cassiopeia's 85.6% came only from domestic playoffs before her 26.20 nerf, and she was 52.1% at MSI. Close call; Cassiopeia is the alternative.

crystal_ball.question: Which champion will have the highest win rate (min 5 games)?
crystal_ball.reason: 60.0% WR (27-18) domestically as a top/support flex, so it reaches 5 games; Qiyana (59.6%) is the alternative Hotspawn tips. High-variance question.

crystal_ball.question: Which champion will have the highest average deaths (min 5 games)?
crystal_ball.reason: Engage supports die most; Nautilus is the most-picked pure engage support (35.9% presence) and leads LEC supports. Alternative: Alistar.

crystal_ball.question: Which pro will have the highest average KDA?
crystal_ball.reason: Highest 2026 KDA among Worlds players (6.97, wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)) over a full-year sample; Chovy's 7.3 came from 11 playoff games. BLG's expected deep run also helps.

crystal_ball.question: Which pro will have the highest average damage per game?
crystal_ball.reason: Leads 2026 damage per game for Worlds players (28,605, wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)) with a 30.3% damage share in LCK playoffs (gol.gg), on a team the model sends deep (P semis 52%).

crystal_ball.question: Which pro will have the highest average kill participation?
crystal_ball.reason: 83.3% KP in LCK playoffs, highest of the LCK playoff samples. Alternatives: Vulcan (81.7%), Career (80.6%).

crystal_ball.question: Peyz vs Gumayusi: more total kills?
crystal_ball.reason: Total kills depend on games played: model gives T1 a slightly deeper run (P semis 52% vs 47%), and Peyz takes more of his team's gold/damage (26.2% gold, 30.3% DMG vs 24.6%/27.5%).

crystal_ball.question: Will Faker reach 700 career Worlds kills this year?
crystal_ball.reason: Needs 84 kills from 616. At his 2026 rate of 3.61 kills per game that is about 24 games (wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)), close to the maximum a team can play at Worlds (roughly 26 for a champion going the distance in long series).

crystal_ball.question: Will Teemo be picked at least once?
crystal_ball.reason: No Teemo in the 298-game domestic playoff sample or the 71-game MSI sample.

crystal_ball.question: How many unique champions will be picked?
crystal_ball.reason: Bands are 0-99, 100-104, 105-109, 110-114, 115-119, 120+ (wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)). Worlds will have about 100 games (6 Play-In Bo5s, 33 Swiss matches, 7 knockout Bo5s); Fearless Draft in every Bo3/Bo5 forces breadth, and Worlds teams used 142 champions across 2026.

crystal_ball.question: Will more games end before or after 32:00?
crystal_ball.reason: 52.1% of 2026 games by Worlds teams ended before 32:00 even though the average is 32:21 (wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)): game length is right-skewed, so the median sits below the mean.

crystal_ball.question: Will any pro get 15+ kills in one game?
crystal_ball.reason: A 15+ kill game happened in 23 of 1,590 games by Worlds teams in 2026 (1.45%, wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)). Over about 100 Worlds games that is 77% at the full rate and about 50% at half the rate (Worlds games are closer, and nobody passed 14 at Worlds 2025, per Hotspawn). Lean Yes.

crystal_ball.question: Will any pro reach 450+ CS in one game?
crystal_ball.reason: 450+ CS happened in 69 of 1,590 games by Worlds teams in 2026 (4.3%, wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)); over about 100 Worlds games at least one is near-certain.

crystal_ball.question: What role will the Finals MVP play?
How many different regions will be in Knockouts?
crystal_ball.reason: Model: 4 regions 54%, 3 regions 22%, 5 regions 22%. History pulls the other way: knockouts averaged 3.3 regions from 2019 to 2025 (wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)), so 3 is a strong alternative.

crystal_ball.question: Will a team from the LCS reach Knockouts?
crystal_ball.reason: Model: 68% that TLAW, LYON or C9 reaches the quarterfinals. History is weaker: the LCS reached knockouts in 3 of the last 7 Worlds (wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)). Blended, slightly above 50%.

crystal_ball.question: Which team places higher: HLE or T1?
crystal_ball.reason: Model: T1 higher 49%, HLE higher 41%, same placement 10%, but this rests on the +0.20 T1 adjustment. HLE lead the head-to-head 5-3 in series (wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)) and 2-1 in 2026. HLE is a reasonable switch.

crystal_ball.question: Which team will win the shortest game?
crystal_ball.reason: Most aggressive early-game top team (76.5% first blood, gol.gg), fastest win among Worlds teams in 2026 (19:20, wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)) and fastest game at MSI 2026 (22:16, Hotspawn).
